concept.title: About the Acme Brewer
concept.shortdesc: The Acme Brewer makes up to eight cups of coffee and keeps it warm for two hours.

conbody.p: Fill the tank, add ground coffee to the basket, and press Brew. A full pot takes about six minutes.

ul.li: Acme Brewer base with water tank

conbody.note: Use filtered water to keep the brewer clean for longer.
